name: The Farm at Star Ridge Aquatics, LLC
tagline: The Farm at Star Ridge Aquatics, LLC at https://starridgeaquatics.com/
description: In 180 Star Ridge Rd, NC, The Farm at Star Ridge Aquatics, LLC grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
